Why would anyone pay for TV when it's free?

Kevin Trudeau tells how he once argued against a satellite TV company. Nobody sits home watching 500 channels, he said. People are out doing things.

The man pitching it replied, you don't see the future. Kevin asked for the company's name and invested anyway.

His lesson: listen to people who have what you want and see further than you do.

What did you once laugh at that turned out to be huge?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

Attitude first, then the money. A 1979 lesson.

Kevin Trudeau recalls being the young kid at a table of wealthy people, asking for advice on making money. The advice: walk into any place like you own it.

Kevin pushed back that it's easy to have that attitude once you have the money. The man answered that the money doesn't give you the attitude. The attitude comes first.

Which comes first for you, the attitude or the proof?
